questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How Germany chooses a new chancellor
The history of Germany's first chancellors
Angela Merkel, her nicknames and how people see her
Why European leaders often meet at summits
questions.why: They talk about Angela Merkel, where her nickname 'mutti' came from and who she really is.

questions.q: How long was Angela Merkel in power?
options: 16 years
6 years
10 years
21 years
questions.why: Sam says she was in office for 16 years, from 2005 until 2021.

questions.q: According to Damien McGuinness, who first used the nickname 'mutti'?
options: German newspapers that admired her leadership
Voters who saw her as a caring mother figure
Other European leaders at international summits
Conservative rivals in her mostly male party
questions.why: He says it started as an insult from hardline conservatives in her predominantly male party.

questions.q: Why was the nickname meant to be ironic?
options: Because she was very young when she became chancellor
Because her style was dry and academic, not warm and cuddly
Because she often talked about her own children
Because she disliked being called by nicknames
questions.why: He says that given her 'dry academic distinctly un-cuddly style', it was meant to be ironic.

questions.q: What fact makes the nickname possibly hurtful, according to the report?
options: She had lost several elections
She came from a poor family
She has no children
She did not speak English well
questions.why: He says it may have been meant to be hurtful, given that in reality she has no children.

questions.q: Which more positive name has the media also given her?
options: The Mother of Germany
The Queen of Europe
The Iron Chancellor
The Leader of the World
questions.why: Neil says the media has also labelled her 'The Queen of Europe'.

questions.q: What does Sam suggest about Merkel's successor?
options: They will not have her experience and authority
They will be more popular than she was
They will keep the nickname 'mutti'
They have been in politics even longer than her
questions.why: Sam says her successor will lack the experience and gravitas she gained over 16 years.

questions.q: What does Damien McGuinness conclude about Merkel?
options: Everyone agrees she was a caring leader
She showed her emotions too often
She was mainly interested in fame
People still don't really know who she is
questions.why: He says she is discreet and people are still not really sure they know who she is.
